calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-12-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/P. Dias, CSR. Valerie Papale.
Petitioner, Catharine Cooper present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to Mary Lee Cooper.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-07-2003 Reset To Jun-05-03 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Commissioner: Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: P.ias, Reporter: Diana Padilla. Petitioner Catharine Cooney was sworn and examined.There being no proof of publication, the Court continues the matter to June 5, 2003.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-09-2003 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: Cause came on for hearing of petition for name change, Pet. appearing in propria persona. Matter ord. off calendar for failure to publish amended petition. Judge: Robert L. Dondero; clerk: Sandra Stark; reporter: Sara Lerschen. (504)

ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Nov-15-2002 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing on Name Change. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Patrick Heard. The Petitioner having filed a defective petition, the Court orders the matter off calendar. The Court advised the Petitioner to file an amended Petition using the same case number and no need to publish again.
